svg.aria-label: One Octet connection carrying three requests, an unknown frame and a malformed frame
svg.title: One Octet connection carrying three requests, an unknown frame and a malformed frame
svg.desc: A client and server share one TCP connection. The client fetches /hello.txt and gets RESPONSE 200 then DATA with END. An unknown frame type 0x7f is skipped. /nope returns 404 on the same connection. A frame with version 2 gets 400 and the server closes.

g.text: Connect once. Frames go back and forth until something is malformed.
skipped whole: room for a v2
connection closed by the server. bcurl never opens a second one.
